create_VizierWorker: create a VizierWorker instance with a valid trial name in projects/location/studies/trials format
add_trial_measurement: add trial measurements with step count and metrics dictionary to Vizier
complete_trial: complete a Vizier trial optionally marking it infeasible with a reason
validate_trial_name: validate that a trial name matches the required projects/location/studies/trials pattern
initialize_vizier_client: initialize a VizierServiceClient configured with the trial's location endpoint
